adjusts.description: Integration (exposure) time in milliseconds, written through SetIntegTime
adjusts.name: integration_time

facts.text: SetIntegTime takes milliseconds, writes iTime * 1e-3 to ExposureTime, and GetIntegTime returns ExposureTime.getValue() * 1000
GetCCDWidth/GetCCDHeight return SensorWidth/SensorHeight and GetPicWidth/GetPicHeight the AOIWidth/AOIHeight
SensorTemperature, SensorCooling, FrameRate and ActualExposureTime are SDK3 camera attributes created in AndorBase.__init__
AndorCamera adds Overlap, TemperatureControl, TemperatureStatus and ActualExposureTime to the AndorBase attributes
TemperatureControl and TemperatureStatus are ATEnum properties; ATEnum.getString returns the current symbol
StopAq calls AcquisitionStop() only when CameraAcquiring is true
The SCMOS viewer reads SensorTemperature.getValue() into the current temperature display and FrameRate.getValue() for the frame rate
The SDK2 camera wrapper documents GetTemperature/GetTemperatureRange in degrees Celcius
The camera image is returned by get_image_fom_buffer(Ny, Nx, buffer) as a uint16 array
